The '''Adari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Adari sector/Legends|Adari sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adari]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft<ref name="EAA" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was discovered two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft. As ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' dates this event to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], it can be determined that this manuscript was published in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the Adarians expanded out into other systems throughout the Adari sector after [[Mining/Legends|harvesting]] most of the Adari system's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="EAA" />
